**Server:** Judge AI Dredd — Test Runner  
**Port:** 3000  
**Version:** See `/status` endpoint for current build version

---

## Overview

This HTTP server provides a wrapper for the Test 7 batch runner and related test frameworks. It listens on port 3000 (ALB requirement) and satisfies health checks while providing a simple API to trigger and monitor batch runs.

---

## Endpoints

### 1. GET `/`

**Description:** HTML status page; serves as ALB health check endpoint  
**Status Code:** Always returns 200 (even if run failed)  
**Response Type:** `text/html; charset=utf-8`  
**Cache Control:** `no-store`

**Response Content:**
- Current run status (idle, running, done, failed)
- Run ID and timestamps (started, finished)
- Process ID (PID)
- Progress metrics (combinations completed, failed, runs completed, last GES value)
- Last 100 lines of log output
- Instructions for starting a new run

**Use Case:** Web UI for monitoring test runs; ALB health check endpoint

---

### 2. GET `/favicon.ico`

**Description:** Serves the favicon for the web interface  
**Status Code:** 200 if found, 404 if not found  
**Response Type:** `image/x-icon`  
**Cache Control:** `public, max-age=86400` (1 day)

**Response Content:** Binary favicon file from `/app/src/web/favicon.ico`

**Use Case:** Browser favicon display

---
